about.title: Policy race: molding-press
about.method: Every policy ran 40 times on the same customer orders, each run 60 days long. Policies with settings to try were tuned first on 30 practice runs with other orders. Ranges are 95% ranges of the average, paired run by run.

recommendation.label: Family campaign
recommendation.sentence: Run family_campaign instead of lowest_cover. It makes $22,088 more per run, about $134,370 more a year.
recommendation.why: Main reason: it spends $35,355 less per run on changeovers, with 33 fewer changeovers to another family.

delta.assumption: A year is 365 days, so about 6.1 runs of 60 days. Each run starts fresh, so this is a rough guide.

confidence.detail: We are 95% sure it earns between $19,733 and $24,444 more per run on average. It came out ahead in 40 of 40 runs.

floor.label: Changeovers to another family per run

drivers.words: it spends $35,355 less per run on changeovers
it spends $1,622 less per run on lost sales
it spends $0 less per run on late orders
it spends $7,195 more per run on making product
it spends $13,098 more per run on keeping stock

policies.label: Family campaign
policies.about: Stay with one family until it is stocked up, then move on.

policies.label: (s, S) reorder
policies.about: The (s, S) rule: refill a product when it drops to s, up to S.

policies.label: Setup aware runout
policies.about: Make what runs out first, but count a product switch as lost days.

policies.label: Kanban
policies.about: Kanban cards: refill a product when it drops under a share of its target.

policies.label: Lowest cover
policies.about: Make the product that will run out first.

policies.label: Lowest stock first
policies.about: Make the product that will run out first.

policies.label: Abc wheel
policies.about: A product wheel where fast sellers come round often and slow sellers rarely.

policies.label: Dollar shortfall
policies.about: Run the product whose missing stock is worth the most money.

policies.label: Fixed wheel
policies.about: Run every product in the same order, a set number of days each.

policies.label: Myopic
policies.about: Pick the choice that makes the most money today, ignoring tomorrow.

policies.label: Random
policies.about: Pick any product, or rest the press, at random.

what_if.note: Policies act the same here. Rerun the race to retune them.
what_if.formula: profit = revenue - production - setup x m1 - holding x m2 - lost_sales x m3 - late
